title: Symmetric-product coordinate morphism
statement:
Let $n\ge1$ and let $\mathbf Z[x_1,y_1,\dots,x_n,y_n]$ be the polynomial ring over $\mathbf Z$ in the $2n$ variables $x_1,y_1,\dots,x_n,y_n$. Define $F_0,\dots,F_n\in\mathbf Z[x_1,y_1,\dots,x_n,y_n]$ as the coefficients, in an auxiliary variable $t$, of

$$
 \prod_{i=1}^n(x_it+y_i)=\sum_{j=0}^nF_jt^j\qquad\text{in }\mathbf Z[x_1,y_1,\dots,x_n,y_n][t].
$$

By [lem-weil-pbc-product-linear-forms-coefficients] (with $R=\mathbf Z[x_1,y_1,\dots,x_n,y_n]$, $a_i=x_i$, $b_i=y_i$),

$$
 F_j=\sum_{J\subseteq\{1,\dots,n\},\ |J|=j}\ \prod_{i\in J}x_i\prod_{i\notin J}y_i\qquad(0\le j\le n),
$$

so $F_0=y_1\cdots y_n$, $F_n=x_1\cdots x_n$, and each monomial of $F_j$ contains, for every $i$, exactly one of $x_i,y_i$, to the first power: $F_j$ is multihomogeneous of degree $(1,\dots,1)$, i.e. of degree one in every pair $(x_i,y_i)$. By the same node, for every commutative ring $R'$ and elements $a_i,b_i\in R'$, $F_j(a_1,b_1,\dots,a_n,b_n)$ is the coefficient of $t^j$ in $\prod_i(a_it+b_i)\in R'[t]$.

The associated rational formula

$$
 ((x_1:y_1),\dots,(x_n:y_n))\longmapsto[F_0:\cdots:F_n]
$$

is, for a scheme $S$ [def-pc-scheme], the name of the symmetric-product morphism $\sigma_n:(\mathbf P^1_S)^n\to\mathbf P^n_S$. This node defines only the polynomials $F_j$; the morphism is constructed in lem-weil-pbc-symmetric-product-properties, part (c), as $\sigma_n=\varphi_{p_n,(\mathcal L_n,(F_0,\dots,F_n))}$ of def-weil-pbc-morphism-to-projective-space-by-sections, with $\mathcal L_n=\bigotimes_i\mathrm{pr}_i^*\mathcal O(1)$, $x_i=\mathrm{pr}_i^*T_0$, $y_i=\mathrm{pr}_i^*T_1$, and $F_j$ read as global sections of $\mathcal L_n$ (that node uses this one, so the reference is a pointer, not a dependency). (Stacks, Etale Cohomology, proof of Lemma 0A4F, indexes the same polynomials in reverse order, $\sum_jF_jt^{n-j}$; here the indexing $\sum_jF_jt^j$ of the blueprint and of all users is kept.)
